title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
title_zh: WeightCode：通过权重空间编程为神经网络安装新能力
abstract_en: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. On ImageNet, four weight programs achieve net gains of 8.84-17.62 points while preserving clean accuracy, outperforming the best of eight fine-tuning methods under matched examples, checks, and retention constraints. In a Vision Transformer, causal interventions show that installed noise-correction gates drive robustness gains, while their selective activation preserves clean accuracy. Rerun on five independently trained Vision Transformers without further language model calls, ten weight programs retain 83-110% of their source-network gains on average, whereas copying their fixed weight edits yields negligible gains. Six programs written for an already edited network add 5.23-14.50 points of contrast robustness while retaining the previously installed noise gain. Together, these results establish WSP as a new route to acquiring and accumulating capabilities in trained neural networks through reusable weight programs.
abstract_zh: WeightCode 是一个权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming，WSP）框架。它让冻结的语言模型根据任务知识和目标网络的现有权重编写可执行程序，直接读取、构造或修改权重，将新的计算逻辑装入已训练网络，无需基于梯度的训练。安装完成后，新能力可独立运行，不再依赖语言模型。实验表明，这种方法能让网络理解未见过的指令组合、学会新的拾取动作，并在保持干净样本准确率的同时提升 ImageNet 上的鲁棒性。对 Vision Transformer 的因果干预表明，噪声校正门控带来了鲁棒性增益，其选择性激活则保留了干净样本准确率。与直接复制固定的权重改动不同，权重程序可在独立训练的网络上重新执行，也能在已编辑的网络上继续安装新能力。
key_points_zh: 给定语法或 8 个示例，未见指令组合的精确匹配率从 0% 提升至 99.8%，新拾取动作的成功率从 0% 提升至 98.4%，原有指令执行和导航能力得以保留。
在 ImageNet 上，4 个权重程序取得 8.84–17.62 个百分点的净增益，同时保持干净样本准确率；在示例、检查和能力保留约束一致的条件下，结果优于 8 种微调方法中的最佳结果。
对 Vision Transformer 的因果干预显示，噪声校正门控是鲁棒性提升的来源，而门控的选择性激活保留了干净样本准确率。
10 个程序在 5 个独立训练的 Vision Transformer 上重新执行，无需再次调用语言模型，平均保留源网络增益的 83%–110%；直接复制固定的权重改动几乎没有增益。
为已编辑网络编写的 6 个程序将对比度变化下的鲁棒性再提升 5.23–14.50 个百分点，同时保留此前获得的噪声鲁棒性增益。
